description: A herbal formulation containing neem extract, turmeric extract and ashwagandha extract in a 2:1:1 ratio for treating inflammatory skin conditions.
notes: Classic TK overlap case — neem, turmeric, ashwagandha are all documented in traditional Ayurvedic texts.

description: Use of curcumin extracted from turmeric for reducing inflammation in joints.
notes: Curcumin/turmeric anti-inflammatory use is heavily documented in prior art and TK sources.

description: A method of treating type 2 diabetes using bitter melon (Momordica charantia) extract orally administered twice daily.
notes: Treatment method may also trigger Section 3(i).

description: A composition containing aloe vera gel and neem oil for treating acne.
notes: Simple mixture of known TK ingredients — Section 3(e) may apply.

description: A new variety of rice plant resistant to bacterial blight disease.
notes: Plant varieties are excluded under Section 3(j).

description: A method for performing laparoscopic surgery using a new trocar placement technique.
notes: Methods of treatment of human body are excluded under Section 3(i).

description: A modified salt form of ibuprofen with improved water solubility.
notes: New salt form of known drug — Section 3(d) requires proof of enhanced efficacy.

description: A business method for calculating insurance premiums based on customer lifestyle data.
notes: Business methods are excluded under Section 3(k).

description: An Ayurvedic formulation containing brahmi, shankhpushpi and ashwagandha for improving memory and cognitive function.
notes: All three herbs are mentioned in classical Ayurvedic texts for cognitive improvement.

description: A composition of giloy (Tinospora cordifolia) and tulsi (Ocimum sanctum) extracts for boosting immunity.
notes: Both herbs and their immunity uses are documented in Ayurvedic texts and TKDL.

description: A nanoparticle-based drug delivery system using curcumin encapsulated in PLGA nanoparticles for targeted delivery to inflamed tissue.
notes: The nanoparticle encapsulation is novel but curcumin use triggers TK concern.

description: A synergistic herbal composition of neem and turmeric in a 3:1 ratio showing antibacterial activity 40% greater than either ingredient alone.
notes: Synergy + specific ratio may distinguish from prior art, but TK concern remains.

description: A microorganism Bacillus subtilis strain XY-77 capable of producing a novel antibiotic compound.
notes: Microorganism patentability under Section 3(j) — requires non-natural occurrence.

description: A computer algorithm that predicts drug-herb interactions using machine learning trained on Ayurvedic text data.
notes: Pure software/algorithm excluded under 3(k); technical implementation may be different.

description: A process for extracting high-purity withanolides from ashwagandha root using supercritical CO2 extraction at 45°C and 250 bar.
notes: Process parameters may be novel but the compound and plant are TK.

description: A polyherbal tablet formulation containing amla, haritaki and bibhitaki (Triphala) with modified-release coating for gastrointestinal conditions.
notes: Triphala is a well-known classical Ayurvedic formulation; modified release coating may add novelty.

description: A new crystalline polymorph of gefitinib with better dissolution characteristics.
notes: New polymorph of known drug — Section 3(d) requires enhanced therapeutic efficacy.

description: A solar-powered water purification device using UV-LED arrays and activated charcoal filtration for rural use.
notes: No obvious patentability exclusion — combination of known components may lack inventive step.

description: A traditional recipe for Chyawanprash with added vitamin C claiming antioxidant and immunity-boosting properties.
notes: Chyawanprash is an ancient documented Ayurvedic formulation — strong TK overlap.

description: A method for detecting adulteration in honey using Raman spectroscopy combined with a novel machine learning classifier.
notes: The spectroscopy + ML combination — hardware component may be patentable; pure ML is not.

description: A novel synthetic derivative of andrographolide (compound from Andrographis paniculata) with modified hydroxyl groups showing 10x greater anti-malarial activity than the parent compound, synthesised through a new five-step process.
notes: Parent compound is TK; synthetic derivative with enhanced activity may overcome 3(d) — requires clinical evidence.

description: A CRISPR-based gene editing method to introduce drought tolerance in wheat by modifying the DREB transcription factor gene.
notes: Plant modification via CRISPR — Section 3(j) exclusion analysis required.

description: An AI-powered diagnostic device that analyses retinal fundus images using a deep convolutional neural network to detect early-stage diabetic retinopathy with 94% accuracy.
notes: Device aspect may be patentable; diagnostic method and pure algorithm may not be.

description: A liposomal formulation of boswellic acids extracted from Boswellia serrata for targeted delivery to arthritic joints with enhanced bioavailability.
notes: Boswellia for arthritis is documented in Ayurvedic texts; liposomal delivery is novel but requires efficacy evidence.

description: A blockchain-based system for tracking the supply chain of Geographical Indication tagged products (e.g. Darjeeling tea) to prevent counterfeiting.
notes: Software/business method concern; hardware implementation may be patentable.

description: A combination therapy using metformin and an extract of Momordica charantia at sub-therapeutic doses showing synergistic glucose reduction in type 2 diabetes.
notes: Method of treatment + TK ingredient + combination with known drug — multiple exclusion angles.

description: A novel mucoadhesive buccal film containing Withania somnifera extract for stress management, providing sustained release over 8 hours.
notes: Drug delivery innovation (buccal film, 8-hour release) may overcome TK concern for the formulation form.

description: A new antibiotic compound isolated from a soil bacterium found in the Thar Desert, showing activity against drug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
notes: Novel compound from natural source — patentability depends on isolation claim; no obvious TK overlap.

description: A quantum dot-based biosensor for detecting trace levels of heavy metals in drinking water, integrating microfluidics and real-time optical readout.
notes: High-tech device — combination of components may lack inventive step if each is known.

description: A personalised Ayurvedic formulation system that uses patient Prakriti (body constitution) assessment via a mobile app to recommend customised herb combinations from a pre-approved set of 50 herbs.
notes: Software/algorithm exclusion (3k) for the app; TK concern (3p) for Prakriti-based formulation concept.
